name: 珊瑚拼图
direction: Friendly coral modularity: a fresh consumer technology marketplace, warm almost-white canvas, solid coral primary actions, muted blue-teal accents and dark blue-grey typography. Confident bold Chinese sans-serif headings paired with simple readable body type, 16–20 logical px cards and a flat matte finish. Signature: two interlocking coral/teal geometric modules forming the mesh brand mark, repeated discreetly as capability badges. Structured warm modernity, not beige serif editorial, not a children’s cartoon, no stickers, no multicolor rainbow.
